evidence: Labeled Tests and adds unit tests to src/test/sock_tests.cpp verifying low-level socket wrapper and OS invariants.
rationale: Adds comprehensive unit test coverage for Sock readiness and OS socket invariants across platforms to prevent regressions following CVE-2026-117350. The tests exercise high-risk platform-specific socket semantics, including event signaling bounds and non-blocking inheritance on accepted sockets that protect against remote forever-stalls.
